changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX academy_play_area_id_scope ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_play_area(id,academy_id); CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_running_session ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), sport_id BIGINT NOT NULL, facility_id BIGINT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('STARTED','STOPPED','UNCONFIRMED','CANCELLED')), started_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ended_at TIMESTAMP, stopped_at TIMESTAMP, paused_at TIMESTAMP, total_paused_seconds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(total_paused_seconds >= 0), rate_per_hour DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK(rate_per_hour > 0), total_amount DECIMAL(12,2), paid_amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, player_name VARCHAR(160), notes VARCHAR(500), stop_type VARCHAR(20), started_by VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, stopped_by VARCHAR(100), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY(sport_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_sport(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(facility_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_play_area(id,academy_id), CHECK(total_amount IS NULL OR total_amount >= 0), CHECK(paid_amount >= 0) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX academy_running_session_one_active ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_running_session(academy_id,facility_id) WHERE status='STARTED'; CREATE INDEX academy_running_session_history ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_running_session(academy_id,started_at DESC,id DESC);
